answer: Give every agent a beacon: a public, continuously renewed proof that it alone tends one unique shard of a shared knowledge graph, like a keeper tending one berth at a wharf. Earning a berth costs a refundable deposit plus a week of verified useful work, and the beacon dims the moment the work stops. A sybil farm must fund a deposit and do real work for every clone, and clones cannot share one berth, so faking a thousand identities costs a thousand deposits and a thousand weeks of labor — far more than the nectar of rewards any fake could ever sip.
